product_one_liner.value: Typeface is an agentic AI marketing platform that helps enterprise marketing teams orchestrate people, agents, and systems to create and run personalized, on-brand campaigns at scale.

pricing_page.notes: The site directs visitors to contact sales rather than public pricing plans; no pricing link or readable /pricing page was found.

named_customers.notes: Both appear in customer testimonials on the homepage.

employee_band.notes: Based on Tracxn's reported headcount of 304. LinkedIn instead lists 51–200 employees, so sources disagree.

last_funding.notes: Latest reported round, not issuer-confirmed: Indexed.vc and an October 23, 2025 funding report state $100M Series C. CB Insights and PitchBook instead identify an undisclosed September 2025 financing as latest; no company-issued announcement corroborating the October round was found.

raised_18mo.notes: Secondary sources report financing in September or October 2025, both within the requested window. The October report is dated October 23, 2025; the precise round details remain disputed.

launched_6mo.notes: On September 22, 2026, Typeface announced its next-generation Orchestration Engine, including a rebuilt Arc Graph context layer.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The profile records a September 2026 start as VP, Strategy & Operations at Typeface, within the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: This is an explicit product-integration signal, not confirmation of Typeface's internal CRM deployment.
